review.posthog_relevance: Replay Vision scanner editor UX and configuration persistence
review.reason: Adds the Eye icon to shared imports and the ICON_MAP registry, and restructures the EditorFooter JSX to conditionally disable the save button and display duration errors for the self-driving step. P1.F5.H4 and P1.F5.H5 implement a draft persistence mechanism for scanner configuration, allowing users to retain work-in-progress across page reloads and retrieve previously saved drafts
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the localized, bounded nature of the changes: adding a UI component and its registry, and adding a draft persistence mechanism. While these are substantive, they do not demonstrate a broader systemic capability or critical path reliability improvement across the entire PostHog platform. observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.

observations.behavior: Adds IconEye to the shared icon import and the ICON_MAP registry.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the Eye icon for use in the onboarding UI, likely for a new feature or status indicator.

observations.behavior: Adds IconEye to the ICON_MAP registry, registering the component for use in the shared utils.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the shared utils to resolve and use the Eye icon component in the onboarding scene.

observations.behavior: Restructures the EditorFooter JSX and changes the duration validation error display. The save button's disabled reason is now conditional on the current step, and an explicit error message is shown for the self-driving step if a duration error exists.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the user experience of the Replay Vision scanner editor. It fixes a potential UX issue where a duration filter error could block the save button even when the user is not yet at the relevant step, and it explicitly displays the duration error for the self-driving step. This could prevent users from saving invalid configurations or help them understand why a save is blocked.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a draft persistence mechanism for scanner configuration, including storage, retrieval, and clearing, with version and team-scoped checks.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows users to retain scanner configuration across page reloads or navigation, preserving work-in-progress before submission.

observations.behavior: Updates scanner loading and submission actions to use the draft, and adds a dedicated clear action.
observations.posthog_connection: Retrieves the previously saved draft and applies it to the scanner state, avoiding redundant user input.

observations.behavior: Adds a dedicated reset action and clears draft on new scanner save, while retaining draft on other saves.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a way to discard the draft and start fresh, while still retaining the draft for other operations.
